company.name: Public
company.shortDescription: Public is a fintech brokerage firm that offers commission-free trading for a variety of asset classes.
company.description:
Public is the investing platform built for those who take it seriously—with technology that makes building a multi-asset portfolio, fast, frictionless, and secure.

Members can invest in stocks, options, bonds, crypto, and contribute to retirement accounts —in the same place. Alongside the robust suite of investing tools, Public offers Alpha, a proprietary AI layer, that provides fundamental data and custom analysis to support informed investment decisions.

productsAndServices.description: A self-directed brokerage platform for investing in stocks, ETFs, bonds, treasuries, options, and cryptocurrency, with fractional investing and portfolio management tools.
productsAndServices.name: Public Multi-Asset Brokerage Platform

productsAndServices.description: Access to corporate bonds, fractional bonds, and U.S. Treasury securities, with tools for screening bonds and constructing Treasury allocations.

productsAndServices.description: A digital-asset trading service that lets users buy, sell, and hold a selection of cryptocurrencies within the Public platform.
productsAndServices.name: Crypto Investing

productsAndServices.description: An API for programmatic access to account data, market data, order placement, and automated trading across equities, ETFs, options, bonds, and crypto.

productsAndServices.description: A natural-language automation service that lets users define rules for monitoring markets, managing cash, and executing recurring trades across stocks, options, and crypto.
